summary: Comprehensive backend testing completed for Nomadly Telegram Bot - IVR option wizard handlers and leads payment system integration verified successfully
passed_tests: Backend health check /api/health returns ok with node running and db connected
API health endpoint returns healthy status with database connected and uptime tracking
IVR option wizard handlers exist: cpIvrOptionKey, cpIvrOptionAction, cpIvrOptionMsg, cpIvrOptionVoice, cpIvrOptionPreview
cpIvrOptionKey handler validates digit input (0-9) and shows used keys with regex validation /^[0-9]$/
cpIvrOptionAction handler offers 3 actions: Forward Call, Play Message, Send to Voicemail
cpIvrOptionMsg handler: for forward asks phone number, for message offers Template/TTS/Upload options
cpIvrOptionVoice handler: language selection with translation + voice selection + TTS generation using ttsService
cpIvrOptionPreview handler: saves option with correct ivrConf.options[key] structure and updatePhoneNumberFeature
'leads-pay' goto handler exists and shows Crypto/Bank/Wallet options using k.pay keyboard
'leads-pay' action handler routes to crypto-pay-leads, bank-pay-leads, or walletSelectCurrency
'crypto-pay-leads' action handler supports both BlockBee and DynoPay payment paths
'bank-pay-leads' action handler sends bank checkout URL with proper payment processing
app.get('/crypto-pay-leads') BlockBee callback exists and processes leads order directly
app.post('/dynopay/crypto-pay-leads') DynoPay callback exists and processes leads order
bankApis has '/bank-pay-leads' handler that processes leads order with checkout functionality
askCoupon + buyLeadsSelectFormat now calls goto['leads-pay']() instead of goto.walletSelectCurrency()
askCoupon + validatorSelectFormat now calls goto['leads-pay']() instead of goto.walletSelectCurrency()
targetLeadsConfirm now calls goto['leads-pay']() instead of direct wallet deduction
dynopayActions.payLeads exists in config.js for proper DynoPay integration
